content.text: Enter Trumpets, sounding; then two Aldermen, Lord Mayor, Garter, Cranmer, Duke of Norfolk with his marshal's staff, Duke of Suffolk, two Noblemen bearing great standing bowls for the christening gifts; then four Noblemen bearing a canopy, under which the Duchess of Norfolk, godmother, bearing the child richly habited in a mantle, etc., train borne by a Lady; then follows the Marchioness Dorset, the other godmother, and Ladies. The troop pass once about the stage, and Garter speaks.

lines.text: Heaven, from thy endless goodness, send prosperous life, long and ever happy, to the high and mighty Princess of England, Elizabeth.
lines.plainText: Heaven from thy endless goodness send prosperous life long and ever happy to the high and mighty Princess of England Elizabeth

lines.text: [Kneeling.] And to your royal Grace and the good Queen,
lines.plainText: Kneeling And to your royal Grace and the good Queen

lines.text: My noble partners and myself thus pray
lines.plainText: My noble partners and myself thus pray

lines.text: All comfort, joy, in this most gracious lady
lines.plainText: All comfort joy in this most gracious lady

lines.text: Heaven ever laid up to make parents happy
lines.plainText: Heaven ever laid up to make parents happy

lines.text: May hourly fall upon ye!
lines.plainText: May hourly fall upon ye

lines.text: Thank you, good lord Archbishop.
lines.plainText: Thank you good lord Archbishop

lines.text: What is her name?
lines.plainText: What is her name

lines.text: Elizabeth.
lines.plainText: Elizabeth

lines.text: Stand up, lord.
lines.plainText: Stand up lord

lines.text: Amen.
lines.plainText: Amen

lines.text: My noble gossips, you've have been too prodigal.
lines.plainText: My noble gossips you've have been too prodigal

lines.text: I thank ye heartily; so shall this lady,
lines.plainText: I thank ye heartily so shall this lady

lines.text: When she has so much English.
lines.plainText: When she has so much English

lines.text: Let me speak, sir,
lines.plainText: Let me speak sir

lines.text: For heaven now bids me; and the words I utter
lines.plainText: For heaven now bids me and the words I utter

lines.text: Let none think flattery, for they'll find 'em truth.
lines.plainText: Let none think flattery for they'll find 'em truth

lines.text: This royal infant—heaven still move about her!—
lines.plainText: This royal infantheaven still move about her

lines.text: Though in her cradle, yet now promises
lines.plainText: Though in her cradle yet now promises

lines.text: Upon this land a thousand thousand blessings,
lines.plainText: Upon this land a thousand thousand blessings

lines.text: Which time shall bring to ripeness. She shall be—
lines.plainText: Which time shall bring to ripeness She shall be

lines.text: But few now living can behold that goodness—
lines.plainText: But few now living can behold that goodness

lines.text: A pattern to all princes living with her
lines.plainText: A pattern to all princes living with her

lines.text: And all that shall succeed. Saba was never
lines.plainText: And all that shall succeed Saba was never

lines.text: More covetous of wisdom and fair virtue
lines.plainText: More covetous of wisdom and fair virtue

lines.text: Than this pure soul shall be. All princely graces
lines.plainText: Than this pure soul shall be All princely graces

lines.text: That mould up such a mighty piece as this is,
lines.plainText: That mould up such a mighty piece as this is

lines.text: With all the virtues that attend the good,
lines.plainText: With all the virtues that attend the good

lines.text: Shall still be doubled on her. Truth shall nurse her;
lines.plainText: Shall still be doubled on her Truth shall nurse her

lines.text: Holy and heavenly thoughts still counsel her.
lines.plainText: Holy and heavenly thoughts still counsel her

lines.text: She shall be loved and feared. Her own shall bless her;
lines.plainText: She shall be loved and feared Her own shall bless her

lines.text: Her foes shake like a field of beaten corn,
lines.plainText: Her foes shake like a field of beaten corn

lines.text: And hang their heads with sorrow. Good grows with her.
lines.plainText: And hang their heads with sorrow Good grows with her

lines.text: In her days every man shall eat in safety
lines.plainText: In her days every man shall eat in safety

lines.text: Under his own vine what he plants, and sing
lines.plainText: Under his own vine what he plants and sing

lines.text: The merry songs of peace to all his neighbours.
lines.plainText: The merry songs of peace to all his neighbours

lines.text: God shall be truly known, and those about her
lines.plainText: God shall be truly known and those about her

lines.text: From her shall read the perfect ways of honour
lines.plainText: From her shall read the perfect ways of honour

lines.text: And by those claim their greatness, not by blood.
lines.plainText: And by those claim their greatness not by blood

lines.text: Nor shall this peace sleep with her; but as when
lines.plainText: Nor shall this peace sleep with her but as when

lines.text: The bird of wonder dies, the maiden phoenix,
lines.plainText: The bird of wonder dies the maiden phoenix

lines.text: Her ashes new create another heir
lines.plainText: Her ashes new create another heir

lines.text: As great in admiration as herself,
lines.plainText: As great in admiration as herself

lines.text: So shall she leave her blessedness to one,
lines.plainText: So shall she leave her blessedness to one

lines.text: When heaven shall call her from this cloud of darkness,
lines.plainText: When heaven shall call her from this cloud of darkness

lines.text: Who from the sacred ashes of her honour
lines.plainText: Who from the sacred ashes of her honour

lines.text: Shall star-like rise as great in fame as she was
lines.plainText: Shall starlike rise as great in fame as she was

lines.text: And so stand fixed. Peace, plenty, love, truth, terror,
lines.plainText: And so stand fixed Peace plenty love truth terror

lines.text: That were the servants to this chosen infant,
lines.plainText: That were the servants to this chosen infant

lines.text: Shall then be his, and like a vine grow to him.
lines.plainText: Shall then be his and like a vine grow to him

lines.text: Wherever the bright sun of heaven shall shine,
lines.plainText: Wherever the bright sun of heaven shall shine

lines.text: His honour and the greatness of his name
lines.plainText: His honour and the greatness of his name

lines.text: Shall be, and make new nations. He shall flourish,
lines.plainText: Shall be and make new nations He shall flourish

lines.text: And, like a mountain cedar, reach his branches
lines.plainText: And like a mountain cedar reach his branches

lines.text: To all the plains about him. Our children's children
lines.plainText: To all the plains about him Our children's children

lines.text: Shall see this and bless heaven.
lines.plainText: Shall see this and bless heaven

lines.text: Thou speakest wonders.
lines.plainText: Thou speakest wonders

lines.text: She shall be to the happiness of England
lines.plainText: She shall be to the happiness of England

lines.text: An aged princess; many days shall see her,
lines.plainText: An aged princess many days shall see her

lines.text: And yet no day without a deed to crown it.
lines.plainText: And yet no day without a deed to crown it

lines.text: Would I had known no more! But she must die,
lines.plainText: Would I had known no more But she must die

lines.text: She must, the saints must have her; yet a virgin,
lines.plainText: She must the saints must have her yet a virgin

lines.text: A most unspotted lily, shall she pass to the ground,
lines.plainText: A most unspotted lily shall she pass to the ground

lines.text: And all the world shall mourn her.
lines.plainText: And all the world shall mourn her

lines.text: O lord Archbishop,
lines.plainText: O lord Archbishop

lines.text: Thou hast made me now a man. Never before
lines.plainText: Thou hast made me now a man Never before

lines.text: This happy child did I get anything.
lines.plainText: This happy child did I get anything

lines.text: This oracle of comfort has so pleased me
lines.plainText: This oracle of comfort has so pleased me

lines.text: That when I am in heaven I shall desire
lines.plainText: That when I am in heaven I shall desire

lines.text: To see what this child does and praise my Maker.
lines.plainText: To see what this child does and praise my Maker

lines.text: I thank ye all. To you, my good Lord Mayor,
lines.plainText: I thank ye all To you my good Lord Mayor

lines.text: And you, good brethren, I am much beholding.
lines.plainText: And you good brethren I am much beholding

lines.text: I have received much honour by your presence,
lines.plainText: I have received much honour by your presence

lines.text: And ye shall find me thankful. Lead the way, lords.
lines.plainText: And ye shall find me thankful Lead the way lords

lines.text: Ye must all see the Queen, and she must thank ye;
lines.plainText: Ye must all see the Queen and she must thank ye

lines.text: She will be sick else. This day, no man think
lines.plainText: She will be sick else This day no man think

lines.text: 'Has business at his house, for all shall stay.
